While Stripe operates in 46 countries, its limitations are well-known. PayPal's restrictions in Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan have left many creators stranded. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, though touted as alternatives, come with their own set of restrictions and limitations. On the other hand, sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, built from the ground up, offers a complete freedom to create, sell, and deliver digital products without relying on any third-party platform. With a sovereign stack, you can host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, all while integrating NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee only.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy all have strict policies regarding countries they serve. While they may claim to operate in multiple countries, their services are often severely restricted in many others. This can lead to account suspensions, fund locks, or even permanent account closures. In contrast, sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is designed to be accessible from anywhere in the world, without the need for any third-party approval or onboarding. With a sovereign stack, you're not bound by any country-specific restrictions or limitations, giving you the freedom to sell digital products to customers worldwide.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, the traditional options often come with hidden charges and long processing times. Stripe, for example, charges a flat 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction, while PayPal's fees can reach up to 4.4% + 30¢. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy, though cheaper, still charge transaction fees and often come with additional costs. In contrast, sovereign digital commerce infrastructure offers a transparent 0.5% fee on all transactions, with no hidden charges or long processing times. This means you get to keep more of your hard-earned money, while your customers enjoy faster and more reliable payment processing.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a permanent structural alternative to traditional payment gateways.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant advantages of sovereign digital commerce infrastructure is the complete ownership and control it offers. With a sovereign stack, you don't have to rely on any third-party platform to host your store, process payments, or deliver digital products. You have full control over every aspect of your ecommerce operation, from data storage to delivery. This means you can automate your store, set up complex workflows, and deliver digital products directly to your customers, all without relying on any external dependencies.

For more advanced creators, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a more comprehensive solution, with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff.
